multi_entity_note: Two parties, Domini Advisor Trust and Domini Social Investments LLC (Sponsor).
processing_note: Any notices under this Agreement shall be in writing addressed and delivered personally, by telecopy or mailed postage-paid to the other party at such address as such other party may designate in accordance with this Section 9 for the receipt of such notice.

contract.document_name.rationale: The heading and preamble both name it 'Sponsorship Agreement'.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement is 'dated as of February 4, 2005'; October 6, 2004 is the Declaration of Trust date.

contract.effective_date.rationale: Section 6 makes it effective as of the day and year first above written, February 4, 2005.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The agreement continues until terminated; no expiry date.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 10 applies the laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: No renewal term; 60 days is a termination notice.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No renewal, hence no non-renewal notice period; the 60 days is termination notice.
